jobs.title: Senior MLOps / Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Scale Kubernetes clusters and vLLM inference gateways for large foundation model training and high-throughput production serving.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS and GCP GKE.
  • Build model serving infrastructure using vLLM, Triton, and Ray Serve.
  • Implement CI/CD automation with ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.
  • Configure Prometheus and Grafana alerting for model latency SLOs.

jobs.descriptionPlain: Build streaming pipelines with Kafka, Spark, and Delta Lake. Maintain zero-loss data replication across multi-region cloud storage.
